description: Meta ad account activity log, including edits made in Ads Manager and other tools. Use ads_list_history for launches and changes made through Ads Uploader. Defaults to the last 7 days; maximum span 90 days. Rows carry objectType AD/AD_SET/CAMPAIGN/AUDIENCE/ACCOUNT plus adSetId/campaignId/audienceId; metaObjectType and extra_data keep Meta’s legacy names (extra_data.campaign_id on an ad is its ad set). A 429 carries Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED carries the time the quota resets (meta.quota.resetsAt).

after.description: Opaque paging.after cursor. Keep filters unchanged.
